title: Counting to 5 with Apples! | Bo & Pip | Buttercup Hollow Stories for Kids
description:
Bo the little elephant wants to bake an apple pie for Grandpa Hoot, but how many apples does he need? Count from 1 to 5 with Bo, Pip and Luna in Buttercup Hollow!

What your child learns:
• Counting 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
• Matching numbers to objects
• Helping friends

Buttercup Hollow is a cozy valley of short learning stories for toddlers and preschoolers (ages 2–6). New stories every week!

#countingforkids #learntocount #toddlerlearning #preschool #kidsstories
thumbnail_prompt: Bo the baby elephant and Pip the chick, excited and smiling, holding a basket full of shiny red apples under a big apple tree, close-up, bright and colorful

scenes.image_prompt: Bo the baby elephant stands in a cozy treehouse kitchen holding a big wooden mixing bowl, looking puzzled with a finger on his trunk
scenes.motion_prompt: the elephant tilts his head and blinks, curious

lines.text: Good morning, Buttercup Hollow!
Ooh, I wonder... Today I want to bake an apple pie for Grandpa Hoot!

scenes.image_prompt: close-up of an open recipe book on a wooden table with a drawing of five red apples, Bo the baby elephant peeking at it

lines.text: The recipe says... five apples.
But how many is five?

scenes.image_prompt: Pip the tiny yellow chick runs happily into the treehouse kitchen towards Bo the baby elephant
scenes.motion_prompt: the little chick hops excitedly and waves its wings

lines.text: Hi Bo! Did somebody say count?
Let's count! Counting is my favorite!

scenes.image_prompt: Bo the baby elephant and Pip the chick walking together on a sunny path towards a big apple tree full of red apples

lines.text: So Bo and Pip went to the big apple tree.

scenes.image_prompt: Bo the baby elephant happily holding up just one red apple with his trunk, under the apple tree

lines.text: I found an apple! Is this five?
Hmm. That's just one apple. One!

scenes.image_prompt: Grandpa Hoot the old owl sitting on a branch of the apple tree, smiling kindly, raising one wing like a teacher
scenes.motion_prompt: the old owl smiles, blinks slowly and lifts one wing

lines.text: Let's think about it together.
We count one apple at a time. Ready?

scenes.image_prompt: one shiny red apple placed in a woven basket on the grass, Bo and Pip looking at it

lines.text: One!
Can you say it with me? One!

scenes.image_prompt: two shiny red apples in a woven basket on the grass, Bo and Pip smiling

lines.text: Two!
One, two!

scenes.image_prompt: three shiny red apples in a woven basket on the grass, Bo gently dropping in an apple with his trunk

lines.text: Three!
One, two, three!

scenes.image_prompt: four shiny red apples in a woven basket on the grass, Pip the chick hopping happily next to it

lines.text: Four!
One, two, three, four!

scenes.image_prompt: exactly five shiny red apples in a full woven basket, Bo, Pip and Grandpa Hoot cheering together
scenes.motion_prompt: the friends cheer happily, the chick jumps, the elephant raises his trunk

lines.text: Five! Five apples!
Let's count them all together. One, two, three, four, five!

scenes.image_prompt: Luna the lavender bunny arrives holding a pie dish, smiling at Bo and Pip with the basket of five apples

lines.text: So pretty! Can I help bake the pie?
Yes! Friends make everything better.

scenes.image_prompt: the four friends sitting around a wooden table in the treehouse with a golden apple pie, Grandpa Hoot looking delighted
scenes.motion_prompt: warm steam rises from the pie, the friends smile and sway happily

lines.text: What a wonderful pie! How many apples did you use?
Five! One, two, three, four, five!

scenes.image_prompt: Bo the baby elephant and Pip the chick waving goodbye at the viewer in front of the red-roofed treehouse at sunset

lines.text: Today we learned to count to five. Great job!
See you next time in Buttercup Hollow!
